briefdescription.para: Phase 5 prompt engineering rewrite engine release-gate benchmarks.

detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency and throughput measurements for the rewrite engine hot paths identified in the prompt engineering module roadmap (Phase 5 — Performance and Hardening). Results are used as release gates; a regression beyond 10% vs. the baseline blocks promotion.

sect2.title: Benchmark families
sect2.para: PEG-01 RewriteEngine::execute() with normalization phase (single pass) PEG-02 RewriteEngine::execute() with policy phase (multi-rule) PEG-03 RewriteEngine::execute() with NL→AQL phase (semantic rewrite)
PEG-04 RewriteRuleLoader::loadFromYAML (100-rule config) PEG-05 RewriteEngine trace generation and audit (100 events)
PEG-06 RewriteEngine step limit enforcement (max_steps boundary)

sect2.title: Hard release gates
sect2.para:
All benchmarks:
Use kPegCanonicalSeed = 42 for deterministic synthetic data.
Run with Repetitions(kRepetitions) to capture variance.
I/O-bound registrations use UseRealTime().
